page.layout: One page of text; running head at top centre; page number at top right; marginal notes in the right margin (three notes: "Lucan.lib.9.", "Tempestas metuenda in arenis Nasamonum"). No left margin notes.

main_text.p: Non secus ac patrys acer Romanus in armis Iniusto sub fasce viam cum carpit, & hosti Ante exspectatum positis stat in agmine castris.
main_text.head: NASAMONES POPVLI maritimi vicini Afris proprie dictis.
main_text.p: — sic cum toto commercia mundo Naufragiys Nasamones habent. hac ire Catonem Dura iubet virtus: illic secura iuuentus Ventorum, nullasque timens tellure procellas, Æquoreos est passa metus. Nam litore sicco, Quam pelago, Syrtis violentius excipit Austrum; Et terra magis ille nocens: non montibus ortum Aduersis frangit Libya scopulisque repulsum Dissipat, & liquidas se turbine soluit in auras: Nec ruit in sylvas, annosaque robora torquens Lassatur. patet omne solum, liberque meatu Æoliam rabiem totis exercet arenis: Et non imbriferam contorto puluere nubem Inflexum violentus agit: pars plurima terra Tollitur, & nunquam resoluto vertice pendet. Regna videt pauper Nasamon errantia vento, Discussaque domos: volitantque a culmine rapta Detecto Garamante casa. non altius ignis Rapta vehit: quantumque licet consurgere fumo; Et violare diem, tantum tenet aera puluis.

page.notes: Right margin notes: "Lucan.lib.9." beside the first lines of the verse; "Tempestas metuenda in arenis Nasamonum." beside the middle. Catchword and signature "M 2" printed at the foot as a signature. Decorative woodcut band below first passage not transcribed. Some words in the verse are uncertain due to the scan's quality.
